site.name: SiteTwin revision: 5G
notes: SiteTwin application: n78 massive-MIMO added on all sectors next to the 4G panels

Synthetic sample for SiteTwin 3D, near Meta's Menlo Park campus. Antenna data and network KPIs are invented; the location is an ordinary city block. It is checked against Turkey's BTK limits like every site here: the US FCC limits are looser and not modelled.
Neighbouring buildings: 82 within 150 m from Microsoft building footprints; uses from OpenStreetMap (1 schools/health/childcare points).
Assumed, not in the SiteTwin file: antenna gain and beamwidths (typical values by band); antenna positions on the roof (sector edge); roof footprint (20 x 16 m).
